summary.value: Also known as Hermetist, Initiate, Theurgist.

system.description:
Built on Project FU's Monk.

FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Mind Points — activated.
  • martial melee proficiency — activated.
  • martial ranged proficiency — activated.

(House note: printed FREE BENEFITS from Monk (Fabula Ultima Stuff/The_Low_Fantasy_Atlas (1).pdf, p.105 (printed; MONK FREE BENEFITS box)) — FU auto-applies the class math; the mechanical fields are activated on the sheet. Rippers handles class identity through the Guise.)

ADEPT SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000001]{Clarity} 【Max SL 3】

Action: destroy a pair of Motes for one cumulative benefit — Immunity to a chosen status; attacks/spells of a chosen damage type ignore Resistances; or Resistance to a chosen type. Up to (SL) benefits active, no repeats.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000002]{Reserve} 【Max SL 3】

Begin a conflict scene with (SL × 2) Motes, up to your limit. Triggers on the Turn when swapping in mid-conflict.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000003]{Restoration} 【Max SL 2】

Action: release Motes toward up to three creatures, 2 MP per Mote. Each delivered Mote restores (SL × 5) HP or MP, your choice. Released Motes are destroyed.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000004]{Discharge} 【Max SL 2】

Action: release any number of Motes as a ranged (DEX + WLP) attack, 2 MP each. Each target loses (SL × 4) HP or MP per Mote — HP against Defense, MP against Magic Defense. Ignores Resistances. Motes are destroyed hit or miss.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000005]{Ward} 【Max SL 3】

Reaction: release Motes (2 MP each) to reduce incoming damage to you or up to three creatures — each Mote reduces the damage by (SL × 2), before Affinities.
